what: Schema files 1052 and 1053 (ten million operations a day): measured on the development host (4 vCPU shared by the database, the load generator and nothing else)

wallet_contention.workload: half the postings credit ONE carrier wallet, half debit ONE gateway clearing wallet; 2,000 passenger wallets on the other side
wallet_contention.reading: the shared wallet row capped postings at 865/s and throughput fell to 688/s at 32 clients (46 ms each); without the row lock postings reach 2,654/s and stay there at 32 clients (12 ms), limited by the 4 CPUs

upgrade_from_1051.how: a database built at 1051 with the previous release, filled by that release's full API suite (217 passed) and db/tools/generate_volume.py (15,034 bookings), then db/upgrade.sh

connection_pooling.how: PgBouncer 1.23.1 (edoburu/pgbouncer:v1.23.1-p3), transaction mode, max_prepared_statements 500, in front of a fresh build; the API's main pool through it
